noticias.titulo: The 10 Most Popular AI ETFs of 2026
noticias.resumo:
You can quibble over whether QQQM counts as an AI ETF, but the Nasdaq-100 has always been a tech proxy, and the tech theme in vogue right now is AI.    
  
QQQM is the cheaper, buy-and-hold-oriented version of the more famous QQQ, tracking the same 100 largest non-financial Nasdaq companies.  The fund is dominated by massive tech companies, most of which are heavily involved in AI, including Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Micron, and Broadcom.
